name: Graven
source:
Graven is a psychological drama set in the city of Kazuul, on the continent of Stradia.

When two folk cross paths in a therapist's waiting room, an unexpected connection forms. Will it offer salvation or deepen their shared pain?

This is a story for the brokenhearted, for the ones who push forward, for the ones who lose themselves in the noise, and for the ones who fight against their inner demons every day. 

[From [url=https://batstudios47.itch.io/graven]Itch.io[/url]]
